description: This file defines data classes representing various output components in a Spark pipeline dataflow graph, such as Output, Table, MaterializedView, StreamingTable, TemporaryView, and Sink, including their properties and relationships.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Base class for definitions of outputs in a pipeline dataflow graph.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Definition of a table in a pipeline dataflow graph, backed by data in storage.

classes.name: MaterializedView
classes.description: Definition of a materialized view in a pipeline dataflow graph.

classes.name: StreamingTable
classes.description: Definition of a streaming table in a pipeline dataflow graph.

classes.name: TemporaryView
classes.description: Definition of a temporary view in a pipeline dataflow graph.

classes.name: Sink
classes.description: Definition of an external sink in a pipeline dataflow graph.
